build: Build 3 content-only controls; both variants use the same signed binary. Separate from unprofiled timing cohorts.
template: Time Profiler + Points of Interest, app-scoped native launch on Homer, no SwiftUI layout tracing enabled.
method: Five exact Reveal page signposts, each +0..180ms. Native time-profile sample weights, including stackless samples in CPU totals. Inclusive region weights overlap; do not sum. Longest callback gaps aligned using raw per-mark uptime offsets.
attribution_limits: One capture per variant; corroborating screen, not repeated performance proof.
Generic graph/layout and ForEach stack frames cannot identify one source component.
CPU sampling and callback alignment do not measure presented frames.
Background parsing/decoding can compete for CPU; absent main-thread stacks do not prove zero indirect cost.
Time Profiler does not collect SwiftUI view/cause data. Earlier SwiftUI-template captures yielded no such data.
